title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on No Longer Approving Cases by Analogy in Accordance with the Law
keywords_en: Cessation of approval of cases applying analogy in accordance with law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on No Longer Approving Analogy Cases in Accordance with the Law

Fa Fa [1997] No. 23

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army:

The revised Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China came into effect on October 1, 1997. With respect to the issues concerning the trial of cases occurring before that date that were subject to analogy, the following notice is hereby given:

1. After October 1, 1997, people's courts at all levels shall no longer submit analogy cases to this Court in accordance with the provisions of Article 79 of the Criminal Law before the revision.

2. For analogy cases that were submitted before September 30, 1997 but had not yet been approved before October 1, 1997, they shall be handled according to the different circumstances in accordance with the provisions of Article 3 of the revised Criminal Law: for acts that required conviction by analogy under the Criminal Law before the revision but are not criminalized under the revised Criminal Law, no conviction or punishment shall be imposed; for acts that required conviction by analogy under the Criminal Law before the revision and are also criminalized under the revised Criminal Law, if criminal liability needs to be pursued, punishment shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of Article 12 of the revised Criminal Law.

3. After October 1, 1997, if people's courts at all levels try cases that occurred before September 30, 1997 and required conviction by analogy under the Criminal Law before the revision, they shall handle the cases in accordance with the provisions of Article 2 of this Notice.

September 22, 1997
